1200:
Oh no, it's starting to rain!
So much for the lawn.

This grass is getting out of hand.
Time to mow.

I'm starving. Time to go in
and find a snack.
Mowing is oddly relaxing.

Did I leave the oven on?
I never remember.

I should buy a mower that
drives itself.

That's enough lawn for one day.
I'm heading in.

Funny, there are lots of ants
out here today.
Here, Biscuit! Come on, boy!

Do snails ever get bored?
I wonder.
It's so quiet in this neighbourhood.

I should be doing my homework.
Wait, I'm a grown-up.
Pacing helps me think.
Is it lunchtime already?

Are those ants marching
in a straight line?

We're out of bread again.
Add it to the list.
I could eat a whole pizza.

What's for dinner?
Not ants, I hope.
What a lovely day to be outside!
Sunshine and fresh air. Perfect.
Look at my hands. Covered in dirt!

Time to put my feet up
and watch some TV.

Nothing good on again.
Why do I even bother?
1210: I am the king of this web.

Come closer, I don't bite.
Much.
La la la, just strolling around.
I only want a quick bite!

Running is just exercise
for my dinner.
Too many ants! Far too many!
1220: Go back to your own hole!
1230: Ha! You fight like a beetle.
1240:
I wonder what I'll be
when I grow up.
Maybe I'll turn out to be a male.
Mmm, someone is licking me clean.
Is anybody going to talk to me?
1250:
Eggs, eggs, eggs.
All day long.
I haven't seen the sun in years.
Does anyone ask how I feel?
My legs ache from all this sitting.

Being queen is not
all it's cracked up to be.
1260:
Is there any food?
Asking for a friend.

Walking is for ants
who aren't tired.
